clear-sky.definition: A sky without clouds, allowing the sun or stars to be seen.

partly-cloudy.definition: A sky with some clouds and some clear areas.

warm-breeze.definition: A light wind that feels warm.

blue-sky.definition: A sky that looks blue because few clouds block the sunlight.

mild-temperature.definition: A temperature that is comfortably warm but not hot.

balmy.definition: Warm and pleasant, especially in a gentle way.

rain.definition: Water that falls from clouds in drops.

drizzle.definition: Light rain falling in very small drops.

downpour.definition: A period of very heavy rain.

puddle.definition: A small pool of water left after rain.

flood.definition: A large amount of water covering normally dry land.

rainbow.definition: A curved band of colours seen when sunlight shines through rain.

umbrella.definition: A covering used to protect someone from rain.

raincoat.definition: A waterproof coat worn in rainy weather.

rain-boots.definition: Waterproof shoes worn in wet weather.

wet-road.definition: A road made wet by rain and sometimes slippery for vehicles.

snow.definition: Frozen water that falls from clouds as soft white flakes.

snowflake.definition: A small piece of frozen water shaped like a six-sided crystal.

ice.definition: Water frozen into a hard solid state.

frost.definition: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces in cold weather.

hail.definition: Small balls of ice that fall from clouds during a storm.

sleet.definition: Frozen or partly frozen rain that falls as small ice pellets.

icicle.definition: A long pointed piece of ice hanging down from a surface.

snowstorm.definition: A severe storm with a lot of falling snow.

frozen-pond.definition: A pond covered with a layer of ice.

fog.definition: A thick cloud near the ground that makes it difficult to see.

thunderstorm.definition: A storm with heavy rain, strong winds, thunder, and lightning.

lightning.definition: A bright flash of electricity in the sky.

thunder.definition: The loud sound that follows lightning.

tornado.definition: A violent column of air that spins around and moves across land.

hurricane.definition: A very powerful storm with strong winds that forms over the sea.

strong-wind.definition: Wind blowing strongly or with great force.

dust-storm.definition: A storm that carries large amounts of dust through the air.

heat-wave.definition: A period of unusually hot weather.

drought.definition: A long period with very little or no rain.

blizzard.definition: A severe snowstorm with strong winds and poor visibility.

barometer.definition: An instrument that measures air pressure and helps predict weather changes.

anemometer.definition: An instrument that measures the speed of the wind.

rain-gauge.definition: An instrument that collects and measures rainfall.

weather-vane.definition: An instrument that points in the direction from which the wind is blowing.

hygrometer.definition: An instrument that measures the amount of moisture in the air.

weather-satellite.definition: A satellite that observes weather from space.

radar-dish.definition: A dish-shaped device used to send or receive radar signals.

weather-balloon.definition: A balloon carrying instruments high into the atmosphere to measure weather.

wind-sock.definition: A fabric tube that shows the direction and strength of the wind.

spring.definition: The season between winter and summer.

summer.definition: The warmest season of the year.

autumn.definition: The season between summer and winter.

winter.definition: The coldest season of the year.

temperature.definition: How hot or cold something is.

humidity.definition: The amount of water vapour in the air.

wind-speed.definition: How fast the wind is moving.

cloud-cover.definition: The amount of the sky covered by clouds.

sunrise.definition: The time when the sun first appears in the sky.

sunset.definition: The time when the sun disappears below the horizon.

sunny.definition: Having plenty of sunshine and few clouds.

cloudy.definition: Covered with many clouds and little direct sunshine.

rainy.definition: Having or bringing rain from clouds in the sky.

snowy.definition: Having or bringing snow from cold clouds in the sky.

windy.definition: Having a lot of wind moving through the air.

stormy.definition: Having strong wind, rain, thunder, or lightning.

foggy.definition: Covered by fog or containing thick fog.

radar.definition: A system that uses radio waves to detect objects or weather.

satellite.definition: A machine sent into space to collect information and send it back.

dew.definition: Small drops of water that form on cool surfaces overnight.
